entities.name: Polina Gurýewa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Polina Aleksandrovna Guryeva is a Turkmenistani weightlifter. She competed at the 2020 Summer Olympics held in Tokyo in 2021 and won a silver medal in the women's 59 kg competition. This was the first ever Olympic medal for Turkmenistan.
